description: AI Toolbox lifecycle hooks for Codex CLI.

hooks.command: echo 'MANDATORY ACTION: Always use the orchestrator-agent. Call mcp__ai__toolbox__nkn_recall at the start of relevant tasks. As soon as the orchestrator classifies the request, write its intent on a line of its own in the form [ai-toolbox] intent=<intent> using the orchestrator intent name; token usage is tagged from that line, so never write it for a guess. For significant decisions, automatically decide whether to call mcp__ai__toolbox__nkn_learn.'
